'''2001 San Diego Comic-Con Coruscant Pre-release (19 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG pre-release (sealed) held at Comic-Con, San Diego, California on 19 July 2001. It is known from Paul McKelvey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2705">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-24-comic-con-coruscant-1d2705/ comic-con-coruscant-1], DeckTech (Paul "Dark Raptor" McKelvey, 24 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-24-comic-con-coruscant-1d2705/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 San Diego Comic-Con Open]].

* '''Date:''' 19 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Comic-Con, San Diego, California
